name: g_mapCellOccupancyFilterTable
comment: Table of two 8-byte filter descriptors {filterFunc, flags} used by Map_FindCellInDirectionEx (0x002D7F20) to filter candidate neighbouring cells. Slot 0 (+0x0, {0x002D7B18 (bx lr stub), 0}) is selected when the cell contains an actor or sub-record (+0x24 != 0); slot 1 (+0x8, {0, 0}) is selected when the cell is empty (+0x24 == 0), causing empty cells to be rejected.
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x002D80F4 in Map_FindCellInDirectionEx (0x002D7F20): loads base 0x00726A00, conditionally adds 8 if actor offset +0x24 is null (addeq r2, r2, #8), loads {r1, r2} via ldm, and tests r1 != 0 || (r2 & 1) != 0. Retail rodata contains {0x002D7B18, 0, 0, 0}.

name: g_fieldMarkerWarpVtable
comment: Vtable (5 slots) for 2D field warp marker node objects (0x18 bytes) allocated by Effect2DWarp (0x001496BC) and linked into the event state marker list (self->f_2c + 8). Slots: [0] null/abstract dtor, [1] deleting destructor (0x004C86BC), [2] no-op update (0x004C8690), [3] Field_Marker_ApplyStoredOffset (0x004C869C), [4] active predicate returning 1 (0x004C8694).
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x001497CC in Effect2DWarp (0x001496BC) where *puVar4 = 0x00778264 installs this table into a newly allocated 24-byte object with target coordinates at +0x12/+0x14. Retail rodata at 0x00778264 contains {0, 0x004C86BC, 0x004C8690, 0x004C869C, 0x004C8694}.

name: g_invalidMapRecordId
comment: Pair of 32-bit sentinel values initialized to -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) at 0x00679328. Word 1 (+0x4) represents the invalid/unassigned map record ID, used by Map_FindRecordById (0x0017C8D8 / 0x002EB9EC) to guard against searching for invalid IDs, by maybe_Container_AddToFirstFreeSlot (0x002EBA64) to detect free slots, and by slot constructors/destructors to initialize and clear slot IDs.
evidence: Referenced via literals 0x002EBA60, 0x002EBB04, 0x002EBC30, 0x00619AE8, and 0x0067933C. Reset to {-1, -1} via mvn r1, #0; str r1, [r0]; str r1, [r0, #4] at 0x00679328. Read at offset +4 by Map_FindRecordById and maybe_Container_AddToFirstFreeSlot, and written to slot->id during slot construction (0x00619A98) and slot reset (0x002EBBF4).

name: g_mapInstanceHandleConfig
comment: Pair of 32-bit values {handleWrapLimit, invalidHandle} (size 8 bytes) for map instance handle allocation. Read by Map_AddInstance (0x0017CBAC) and maybe_Map_AddInstanceIfVisible (0x0017CC38); word 0 (+0x0) defines the upper bound at which table->f_e4 wraps back to 0, and word 1 (+0x4) is the fallback invalid handle returned when allocation fails.
evidence: Referenced via literals 0x0017CC20 and 0x0017CCAC in Map_AddInstance and maybe_Map_AddInstanceIfVisible. Word 1 (puVar1[1]) is loaded as the failure return value, and word 0 (*puVar1) is compared against next_handle to wrap table->f_e4 back to 0. Zero-initialized under static guard at 0x0067E088.
